 *

 * (auto-renders controls via addBuilderKnobRow in app.js).
 *
 * Per-knob field reference:
 *   type     : 'number' | 'color'                 (required — omit to skip UI render)
 *   label    : human-readable label for builder UI (required)
 *   default  : default value (MUST match the CSS var(--fx-<knob>, <default>)
 *              fallback — they live in two places by design and must agree)
 *   min/max  : numeric range  (number type)
 *   step     : numeric granularity (number type)
 *   unit     : appended when setting the CSS var ('s', 'px', 'deg', ...).
 *              Omit for unitless 0-1 ratios / counts.
 *
 * Metadata keys (no 'type') are skipped by the builder UI:
 *   renderer : 'particle' — marks effects that use particle_engine.js
 *
 * Shared positioning knobs (all particle effects):
 *   origin_x        : horizontal offset from element centre (px)
 *   origin_y        : vertical offset from element centre (px)
 *   canvas_rotation : rotates the entire canvas container around element centre (deg)
 *
 * Directional particle effects also expose:
 *   range            : half-width of the spawn line (px) — tighten/widen spread
 *   particle_rotation: rotates each particle's velocity vector (deg)
 *
 * Ambient particle effects expose:
 *   range            : spawn circle radius from origin (px)
 *
 * CSS variable naming: underscores in the knob key become hyphens in CSS, so
 * the knob `line_opacity` is read in CSS as `var(--fx-line-opacity, default)`.
 * Color knobs use `color1`…`colorN` (→ `--fx-color1`…`--fx-colorN`).
 */

function glowMetrics(distanceValue, spreadValue, fadeValue) {
    const glowDistance = sanitizeGlowDistance(distanceValue);
    const glowSpread = sanitizeGlowSpread(spreadValue);
    const glowFade = sanitizeGlowFade(fadeValue);

    const baseDistance = glowDistance !== null ? glowDistance : 8;
    const spreadPercent = glowSpread !== null ? glowSpread : 100;
    const nearScale = 0.7 + (spreadPercent * 0.003);
    const farScale = 1.0 + (spreadPercent * 0.011);
    const blurScale = 0.1 + (spreadPercent * 0.0008);
    const nearRadius = Math.max(0.8, baseDistance * nearScale);
    const farRadius = Math.max(1.6, baseDistance * farScale);
    const frontBlur = Math.max(0.35, baseDistance * blurScale);

    let nearTransparent = 44;
    let farTransparent = 64;
    let nearBoostTransparent = 30;
    let farBoostTransparent = 50;
    let nearDimTransparent = 68;
    let farDimTransparent = 84;
    let frontOpacity = 0.55;

    if (glowFade !== null) {
        nearTransparent = Math.min(92, Math.max(12, 15 + (glowFade * 0.55)));
        farTransparent = Math.min(98, Math.max(28, nearTransparent + 18));
        nearBoostTransparent = Math.max(0, nearTransparent - 14);
        farBoostTransparent = Math.max(8, farTransparent - 14);
        nearDimTransparent = Math.min(98, nearTransparent + 24);
        farDimTransparent = Math.min(99, farTransparent + 20);
        frontOpacity = Math.max(0.14, Math.min(0.86, ((100 - glowFade) / 100) + 0.08));
    }

    return {
        nearRadius: `${fixed(nearRadius)}px`,
        farRadius: `${fixed(farRadius)}px`,
        frontBlur: `${fixed(frontBlur)}px`,
        nearTransparent: `${fixed(nearTransparent)}%`,
        farTransparent: `${fixed(farTransparent)}%`,
        nearBoostTransparent: `${fixed(nearBoostTransparent)}%`,
        farBoostTransparent: `${fixed(farBoostTransparent)}%`,
        nearDimTransparent: `${fixed(nearDimTransparent)}%`,
        farDimTransparent: `${fixed(farDimTransparent)}%`,
        frontOpacity: fixed(frontOpacity),

    function renderBadges(parent, data) {
        if (!showBadges()) return;
        const badges = data && typeof data.badges === 'object' && data.badges ? data.badges : {};

                node.remove();
            }
        });
        const anchor = parent.querySelector('.cc-name-base');
        if (data && data.type === 'discord') {

    function appendBadges(parent, data) {
        renderBadges(parent, data);

        // when a cold badge-map request completes, without delaying chat.
        badgeMapReady.then(() => renderBadges(parent, data));

    function decorationBase(data) {
        const decorations = data && typeof data.decorations === 'object' ? data.decorations : {};
        const option = decorations && typeof decorations.name_base === 'object' ? decorations.name_base : null;
        return option;
    }

    function decorationMessage(data) {
        const decorations = data && typeof data.decorations === 'object' ? data.decorations : {};
        const option = decorations && typeof decorations.message_text === 'object' ? decorations.message_text : null;
        return option;
    }

    function hasInlineEmotes(rawText, emotes) {
        const map = emotes && typeof emotes === 'object' ? emotes : {};
        return text(rawText).split(/\s+/).some((chunk) => chunk && safeImageUrl(map[chunk]));
    }

    // The viewer's Message style. A text-only message gets the full renderer (glow,
    // gradient, effects); one with emotes keeps its emotes and only takes the face and
    // colour, because the renderer replaces the node's contents with plain text.
    // Returns true when the message text has been written into `message`.
    function applyMessageStyle(message, data) {
        const option = decorationMessage(data);
        if (!option) return false;
        message.classList.add('cc-text-styled');
        const translator = overlay && overlay.nameTranslator && typeof overlay.nameTranslator.applyTagPresentation === 'function'
            ? overlay.nameTranslator
            : window.DECORATION_NAME_TRANSLATOR;
        if (!hasInlineEmotes(data.text, data.twitch_emotes) && translator && typeof translator.applyTagPresentation === 'function') {
            // the builder's size and offsets are for the big card; chat keeps its own rhythm
            const presentation = { ...option, text: text(data.text), font_size: '', offset_x: '', offset_y: '' };
            translator.applyTagPresentation(message, presentation, 'cc-text cc-text-styled message-text name-tag');
            return true;
        }
        const family = text(option.font_family).replace(/["\\]/g, '').trim();
        if (family) message.style.fontFamily = `"${family}", var(--cc-body-font)`;
        if (option.font_weight) message.style.fontWeight = text(option.font_weight);
        if (option.font_style) message.style.fontStyle = text(option.font_style);
        if (option.letter_spacing) message.style.letterSpacing = text(option.letter_spacing);
        const color = safeColor(option.text_color);
        if (color) message.style.color = color;
        return false;
    }

    function appendEmoteTag(parent, data) {
        if (!data || data.type === 'discord') return;
        const tag = data.emote_tag && typeof data.emote_tag === 'object' ? data.emote_tag : null;
        const src = safeImageUrl(tag && tag.src);
        if (!tag || !tag.name || !src) return;
        const image = document.createElement('img');
        image.className = 'cc-emote-tag';
        image.src = src;
        image.alt = text(tag.name);
        image.title = text(tag.name);
        parent.appendChild(image);
    }

    function createName(data, parent) {
        const name = text(data && (data.username || data.from) || 'Unknown');
        const nameNode = document.createElement('span');
        nameNode.className = 'cc-name-base name-base name-tag';
        const color = safeColor(data && (data.color || data.nameColor));
        if (color) nameNode.style.color = color;
        const option = decorationBase(data);
        const presentation = option ? { ...option, text: name } : null;
        const hasDecorationGradient = Array.isArray(presentation && presentation.text_gradient)
            && presentation.text_gradient.length >= 2;
        if (presentation && color && !presentation.text_color && !hasDecorationGradient) {
            presentation.text_color = color;
        }
        if (option && overlay && overlay.nameTranslator && typeof overlay.nameTranslator.applyTagPresentation === 'function') {
            overlay.nameTranslator.applyTagPresentation(nameNode, presentation, 'cc-name-base name-base name-tag');
        } else if (window.DECORATION_NAME_TRANSLATOR && typeof window.DECORATION_NAME_TRANSLATOR.applyTagPresentation === 'function' && option) {
            window.DECORATION_NAME_TRANSLATOR.applyTagPresentation(nameNode, presentation, 'cc-name-base name-base name-tag');
        } else {
            nameNode.textContent = name;
        }
        parent.appendChild(nameNode);
    }

    function createUserInfo(data, includeColon = true) {
        const info = document.createElement('span');
        info.className = 'cc-user-info';
        appendEmoteTag(info, data || {});
        appendBadges(info, data || {});
        createName(data || {}, info);
        if (includeColon) {
            const colon = document.createElement('span');
            colon.className = 'cc-colon';
            colon.textContent = ':';
            info.appendChild(colon);
        }
        return info;
    }

    function appendTextWithEmotes(parent, rawText, emotes) {
        const value = text(rawText);
        const map = emotes && typeof emotes === 'object' ? emotes : {};
        const chunks = value.split(/(\s+)/);
        chunks.forEach((chunk) => {
            if (!chunk) return;
            if (/^\s+$/.test(chunk)) {
                parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(chunk));
                return;
            }
            const src = safeImageUrl(map[chunk]);
            if (!src) {
                parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(chunk));
                return;
            }
            const image = document.createElement('img');
            image.className = 'cc-emote-inline';
            image.src = src;
            image.alt = chunk;
            image.title = chunk;
            parent.appendChild(image);
        });
    }

    function createLine(data) {
        const line = document.createElement('div');
        const tier = text(data.tier).toLowerCase();
        const legacy = Number(data.legacy) || 0;
        line.className = 'cc-line cc-chat';
        if (tier === 'discord' || data.type === 'discord') line.classList.add('cc-discord');
        else if (tier === 'mod') line.classList.add('cc-mod');
        else if (legacy >= 2 || tier === 'legendary') line.classList.add('cc-legendary');
        else if (tier === 'vip') line.classList.add('cc-vip');
        else if (legacy === 1 || tier === 'legacy1') line.classList.add('cc-legacy');
        const msgClass = lower(data.msg_id_kind || data.message_class);
        if (msgClass === 'highlighted-message') line.classList.add('cc-highlight');
        if (msgClass === 'message-effect') line.classList.add('cc-highlight-effect');
        line.dataset.msgId = text(data.msg_id);
        line.dataset.username = lower(data.username);
        if (line.classList.contains('cc-legendary')) {
            const comet = document.createElement('span');
            comet.className = 'cc-comet';
            comet.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            line.appendChild(comet);
        }
        line.appendChild(createUserInfo(data));
        const message = document.createElement('span');
        message.className = 'cc-text';
        if (!applyMessageStyle(message, data)) appendTextWithEmotes(message, data.text, data.twitch_emotes);
        line.appendChild(message);
        return line;
    }

    function createEmoteImage(emote, giant) {
        const src = safeImageUrl(emote && (emote.src || emote.url));
        if (!src) return null;
        const image = document.createElement('img');
        image.src = src;
        image.alt = text(emote && (emote.name || 'emote')) || 'emote';
        image.className = giant ? 'cc-emote-inline cc-giga-asset' : 'cc-emote-inline';
        return image;
    }

    function createSpecial(data, kind) {
        const special = document.createElement('div');
        special.className = `cc-special cc-${kind}`;
        const msgClass = lower(data.msg_id_kind || data.message_class);
        if (msgClass === 'highlighted-message') special.classList.add('cc-highlight');
        if (msgClass === 'message-effect' || data.message_effect) special.classList.add('cc-highlight-effect');
        special.dataset.msgId = text(data.msg_id);
        special.dataset.username = lower(data.username);

        const slip = document.createElement('div');
        slip.className = 'cc-special-slip';
        const user = document.createElement('span');
        user.className = 'cc-special-user';
        appendEmoteTag(user, data);
        appendBadges(user, data);
        createName(data, user);
        const colon = document.createElement('span');
        colon.className = 'cc-colon';
        colon.textContent = ':';
        user.appendChild(colon);
        slip.appendChild(user);

        const assets = document.createElement('span');
        assets.className = 'cc-special-assets';
        (Array.isArray(data.emotes) ? data.emotes.slice(0, 12) : []).forEach((emote) => {
            const image = createEmoteImage(emote, Boolean(data.giant));
            if (image) assets.appendChild(image);
        });
        if (kind === 'bits') {
            parseBits(Number(data.amount) || 0).forEach(({ tier, count }) => {
                for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
                    const image = createBitImage(tier);
                    if (image) assets.appendChild(image);
                }
            });
            if (data.message) {
                const message = document.createElement('span');
                message.className = 'cc-special-message';
                message.textContent = ` ${text(data.message)}`;
                slip.appendChild(message);
            }
            slip.appendChild(assets);
            special.appendChild(slip);
            return special;
        }

        special.appendChild(slip);
        special.appendChild(assets);
        return special;
    }

    // Archived fullscreen chat contract: largest-first tiers, with a 50+ bit
    // remainder rounded into one 100-bit icon. Keep this exact for compact chat.
    function parseBits(total) {
        const tiers = [10000, 5000, 1000, 100];
        const result = [];
        const numeric = Number(total);
        let remainder = Number.isFinite(numeric)
            ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1000000, Math.floor(numeric))) : 0;
        for (const tier of tiers) {
            const count = Math.floor(remainder / tier);
            if (count > 0) {
                result.push({ tier, count });
                remainder -= count * tier;
            }
        }
        if (remainder >= 50) {
            const last = result[result.length - 1];
            if (last && last.tier === 100) last.count += 1;
            else result.push({ tier: 100, count: 1 });
        }
        return result;
    }

    function createBitImage(tier) {
        const src = safeImageUrl(`https://static-cdn.jtvnw.net/bits/dark/animated/${tier}/4`);
        if (!src) return null;
        const image = document.createElement('img');
        image.className = 'cc-bit-icon';
        image.src = src;
        image.alt = `${tier} bit`;
        const sizes = { 10000: 24, 5000: 22, 1000: 20, 100: 16 };
        const size = sizes[tier] || sizes[100];
        image.style.width = `${size}px`;
        image.style.height = `${size}px`;
        return image;
    }

    function createAchievement(data) {
        const achievement = document.createElement('div');
        achievement.className = 'cc-achievement';
        if (data.is_founder) achievement.classList.add('cc-founder');
        achievement.dataset.username = lower(data.username);

        const found = document.createElement('span');
        found.className = 'cc-achievement-page cc-achievement-found';
        const foundText = document.createElement('span');
        foundText.className = 'cc-achievement-text';
        foundText.textContent = `Achievement Found by ${text(data.username || 'Unknown')}`;
        found.appendChild(foundText);
        const name = document.createElement('span');
        name.className = 'cc-achievement-page cc-achievement-name';
        const nameText = document.createElement('span');
        nameText.className = 'cc-achievement-text';
        nameText.textContent = text(data.ach_name || data.name || 'Achievement');
        name.appendChild(nameText);
        rotator.appendChild(found);
        rotator.appendChild(name);
        achievement.appendChild(rotator);
        return achievement;
    }

    function removeBy(predicate) {
        Array.from(stack.children).forEach((node) => {
            if (predicate(node)) node.remove();
        });
    }

    function scheduleExpiry(node) {
        const delay = durationMs();
        if (delay > 0) window.setTimeout(() => node.remove(), delay);
    }

    let pruneFrame = 0;

    function pruneStack() {
        pruneFrame = 0;
        while (stack.children.length > maxMessages()) {
            stack.firstElementChild?.remove();
        }

        const visibleHeight = stack.clientHeight;
        if (visibleHeight <= 0) return;
        while (stack.children.length > 1 && stack.scrollHeight > visibleHeight + 1) {
            stack.firstElementChild?.remove();
        }
    }

    function schedulePrune() {
        if (pruneFrame) return;
        pruneFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(pruneStack);
    }

    function appendNode(node) {
        stack.appendChild(node);
        node.querySelectorAll('img').forEach((image) => {
            if (!image.complete) image.addEventListener('load', schedulePrune, { once: true });
        });
        schedulePrune();
        scheduleExpiry(node);
    }

    function handleStreamEvent(data) {
        if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return;
        const type = lower(data.type);
        if (type === 'burn_msg') {
            const id = text(data.msg_id || data.message_id);
            if (id) removeBy((node) => node.dataset.msgId === id);
            return;
        }
        if (type === 'burn_user') {
            const username = lower(data.username);
            if (username) removeBy((node) => node.dataset.username === username);
            return;
        }
        let node = null;
        if (type === 'chat' || type === 'discord') node = createLine(data);
        else if (type === 'emote') node = createSpecial(data, data.giant ? 'giga' : 'emote-only');
        else if (type === 'bits') node = createSpecial(data, 'bits');
        else if (type === 'achievement') node = createAchievement(data);
        if (node) appendNode(node);
    }

    function setMotion() {
        root.classList.toggle('cc-motion-off', fields.motion === false || fields.motion === 'false');
    }
    setMotion();
    window.addEventListener('resize', schedulePrune);
    if (document.fonts?.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(schedulePrune).catch(() => {});
    if (typeof overlay.onStreamEvent === 'function') overlay.onStreamEvent(handleStreamEvent);
